text:
jordan: quick heads-up — onboarding sample (go + py) has confusing retry guidance. It tells users to "retry on transient errors" but doesn't explain auth vs permission errors.

mira: can you point to the exact spot?

jordan: sampleapp/go/README.md says "retry failed requests" and sample code retries on any 4xx/5xx. snippet: ```go
if resp.StatusCode >= 400 && resp.StatusCode < 600 {
  retry()
}
```

liam: that's bad — 401 should trigger a single refresh attempt, 403 shouldn't be retried at all. Treating them the same caused auto-refresh loops in a customer demo.

mira: we need two things: (1) fix the Go sample and call out auth vs permission; (2) align SDK error envelope so app logic can inspect retry_hint instead of status codes.

jordan: proposal for envelope: code, message, http_status, retry_hint (none|refresh|backoff|idempotent), recovery_hint. sample snippet in README: ```pseudo
if err.retry_hint == "refresh" { refresh_token(); retry_once() } else if err.retry_hint == "backoff" { exponential_backoff() } else { surface_error() }
```

liam: i'll prepare a Go PR to special-case 401 and 403 in MapHTTPStatusToError and add tests. branch: fix/4xx-retry-hints

ci-bot: CI: retry-matrix failed (2 tests) https://ci.example.com/9999

qa-bot: RW-4010 created: "Standardize SDK error envelope + update onboarding samples" assigned to liam. Test matrix includes 401/403/429/idempotency.

devrel-bot: recommend updating the quickstart to show Idempotency-Key for POSTs and a short table: when to retry vs refresh vs abort.

mira: agree. docs PR + sample PR should land together. i'll own docs. let's aim EOD for PRs.

jordan: also add a small lint check in sample CI to detect ">=400 && <600" retry patterns and fail the sample build. that should prevent regressions.

liam: will add unit tests and the lint. thanks.

mira: thanks all. rolling this out should reduce support noise and make onboarding safer.
